glosario.titulo: Draft 20 Glossary: draft, auction, bid and more
glosario.desc: All Draft 20 terms explained: draft, auction, bid, I'M OUT, ⭐ value, 4-item cap, deadlock, rematch and series.
glosario.intro_antes: The terms that appear in the game and in the guides, explained in one sentence. If you're new here, start with

terminos.def: A format where a fixed budget is spread across a list of items and you have to build the best possible selection. In Draft 20, each player gets 20 coins.
Each round an item comes up and the two players bid in turns. When someone drops out, the last bidder pays the price and takes the item.
An offer that raises the current price of the item. In Draft 20 there are only two buttons: BID +1 and BID +3.
Withdraw from the auction. If your rival is the last bidder, they pay the price and keep the item; you spend nothing.
The player who set the current price. If their rival drops out, they pay and take the item; that's why it pays to time your bids.
The intrinsic quality of each item, on a scale from 1 to 10. It stays secret until the end of the game and decides the winner.
Each item up for auction: a character, an object or a dish. Every theme has 20 different items.
The list of 20 items the game is played with (soccer, anime, food, streamers…). Draft 20 has 69 themes.
Maximum items per player. Once you reach 4, any items that come up later go straight to your rival.
If a fresh item comes up and you have no money, press PASS: your rival decides whether to keep it for 1 🪙 or give it to you.
Optional mode that shows each item's ⭐ during the game. It is set by whoever creates the room and affects both players.
At the end, either player can propose a rematch with a new theme; the rival accepts or declines it from the final screen.
Rematch score against the same rival: whoever wins two games takes the series.
A machine-controlled rival with four levels: Easy, Normal, Hard and Extreme. It lets you practice without a human opponent.

faq.a: Each completed game adds one point to its theme in the current month. The order of each month is the number of finished games, and ties are broken in alphabetical order so that the ranking is stable.

faq.q: Does the ranking show names or personal information?
faq.a: No: only organized theme names, without figures, without player names or identifiers. Registration is completely anonymous.

faq.q: Why doesn't my favorite theme appear?
faq.a: Only themes with games completed that month appear. Play a game and you will automatically enter the ranking.

terminos.meta_desc: Draft 20 Terms of Use: Free service without registration, expected behavior and game availability.
terminos.intro: By playing Draft 20 you accept these conditions. They are short and in normal language.

p: Draft 20 is a free-to-play turn-based bidding game for two players, accessible in the browser without creating accounts or installing anything. There are no payments, subscriptions or real coins: the 20 coins are the budget of each game and have no value outside of the game.

You can create rooms, invite whoever you want and play all the games you want. You are not allowed to automate the game with external bots, interfere with the service or use it for purposes other than playing. Offensive names may be expelled from the rooms.

The service is offered as is, without guarantees of permanent availability. It may be discontinued for maintenance or technical reasons, and may be modified or withdrawn without prior notice. The games in progress depend on the connection of both players.
The names of characters, works and brands mentioned in the themes are used for entertainment and reference purposes; the project is not affiliated with or endorsed by its owners.

seo.home_desc: Play Draft 20 for free: turn-based auction for 2 players. Bid with 20 coins on items from {n} themes and whoever gets the most ⭐ wins. No registration.
seo.hero_texto: Draft 20 is the auction game for two players: 8 rounds, 20 coins and one theme per game. Bid in turns, drop out on time and take the best items. The value of each item is secret until the end.
seo.como_paso1: Create a room and share the code with your rival (or practice against the bot).
seo.como_paso2: Choose a theme from {n} available, from Soccer to Pizza.
seo.como_paso3: Auction in turns: BID +1, BID +3 or I'M OUT.
seo.como_paso4: Whoever collects the most ⭐ wins; if there is a tie, whoever keeps the most coins wins.
seo.tematicas_sub: {n} themes with 20 items each. Choose one to see its full list.
seo.tematica_dia_sub: See its list of 20 items and create a game in 1 click.

faq.a: Draft 20 is a turn-based bidding game for two players. Each game has 8 rounds and a theme (soccer, anime, food, streamers...): you bid on items with 20 coins and whoever gets the most ⭐ wins.

faq.q: How long does a game last?
faq.a: A complete game is 8 rounds, about 5 minutes. You can chain several in a row with the rematch button.

faq.q: Do I need to register or download something?
faq.a: No. Draft 20 is free, it is played in the mobile browser and does not require an account: create a room and share the code or link with your rival.

faq.q: Can I play alone against the machine?
faq.a: Yes. Practice mode pits you against a bot with four difficulties: Easy, Normal, Hard and Extreme.
{n} themes with 20 items each, from Soccer or Anime to Pizza, Tapas and Bar or Streamers. If you choose "All", one is drawn at random.

seo.cta_final: Ready to bid? Create a free room
seo.tematica_intro: These are the 20 items of the {t} theme that can appear in the Draft 20 auction. The value of each item is secret until the end: bid wisely and take the best.
seo.como_jugar_desc: Complete guide to Draft 20: objective, turns, bids, maximum of 4 items, tiebreakers and rematch. Learn to play in 2 minutes.
seo.como_jugar_intro: Draft 20 is played on mobile, in turns and against another person (or against the bot). These are the complete rules.
seo.prep_texto: Create a room, choose a theme (or leave "All" to be drawn) and share the 5-character code with your rival. You can also practice against the bot on four difficulties.
seo.bot_texto: The bot plays by the same rules as you. Easy and Normal guess item values (with varying accuracy), Hard knows them and manages its budget, and Extreme plays aggressively with the real values. Each level is calibrated against an average player (30/50/70/90% win rates).
seo.revancha_texto: At the end, either of the two can propose a rematch with a new theme. The opponent accepts or rejects it from the final screen.
consejos: Don't waste your 20 coins on the first round: the good items tend to come mixed in.
I'M OUT when the rival is the last bidder: they pay and you risk nothing.
With 4 items you are at the maximum: the next ones pass to your rival.
If you run out of coins, pass the item and your rival decides: keep it for 1 🪙 or give it to you.
seo.acerca_desc: What Draft 20 is, where the 20-coin draft idea comes from and who is behind it.
seo.acerca_p1: Draft 20 was born from a viral format: the “You have $20” videos in which a fixed budget is distributed among a list of items. The trick is in choosing well, not in being able to pay more than anyone else.
seo.acerca_p2: The idea is to turn that dynamic into a quick two-player duel: one theme, 20 items, 20 coins and 8 rounds of turn-based bidding. Five minutes, a rematch and on to something else.
seo.acerca_p3: It is an independent project made in Spain, with no accounts, no downloads and no advertising. If you have ideas, suggestions or find a bug, write to us.
seo.contacto_desc: Contact Draft 20 for questions, suggestions, errors or collaborations.
seo.contacto_texto: For questions, suggestions, bugs or collaborations, write to us by email. We reply as soon as possible.
seo.contacto_extra: Tell us what you were doing when it happened (theme, phone or computer) and, if it was a bug, what you expected to happen. We usually reply within a couple of days.
seo.privacidad_desc: Draft 20 privacy policy: minimum data and control of your preferences.
seo.privacidad_intro: Draft 20 is designed to play without registration and with minimal data. This is what you need to know.
seo.priv_datos_texto: There are no accounts or profiles. Rooms only store the name you type (optional) and the game status on the server, and are automatically deleted after a few hours. When a practice game ends, an anonymous record is saved (level, mode, result and moves; without names or identifiers) to calibrate the bot's difficulty. When any game ends, including against the CPU, an anonymous record is saved (theme, mode, time and result; without names or identifiers) for the statistics of modes played.
seo.priv_local_texto: Your browser saves game data in localStorage (room session, wins record, bot difficulty and a record of your practice games) and your cookie choice. It never leaves your device and you can delete it by clearing the site's data.
seo.priv_metricas_texto: We count visits and games with aggregated and anonymous counters (without cookies or identifiers). We also use Google Analytics 4 (gtag.js tag) to understand the use of the site: if you accept, it installs its own cookies (_ga) and processes the IP for approximate geolocation (Google does not store it). If you reject, no cookies are installed; only aggregated anonymous signals can be sent for modeling. You can change your choice under "Cookies", disable it with the opt-out plugin tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout and see how Google uses data at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.
seo.priv_terceros_texto: Currently the pages do not display advertising or use advertising cookies. Google Analytics 4 only installs cookies if you accept in the notice; if you decline, it doesn't install them and only aggregated anonymous signals can be sent for modeling. Our own metrics also work (aggregated counters, without cookies) and tools like Search Console. If advertising is incorporated in the future, this page will be updated and the consent notice will allow you to accept or reject that purpose as well.
seo.priv_contacto_texto: For any questions about privacy, write to contacto@draft20.es.
